articles.summary: AutoNation, Inc. (NYSE: AN), today announced that its Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, Tom Szlosek, will participate in Morgan Stanley’s 14 th Annual Laguna Conference on Thursday, September 17, at 7 a.m. Pacific time. Mr. Szlosek will speak to investors in a fireside chat about the Company’s strategy, financial performance, capital allocation, current trends affecting the business, and other related matters. A live webcast of the event will be available on the Company’s Investor Relations website under “Events Presentations” at investors.autonation.com . A replay will be available following the event at the same location. About AutoNation, Inc. AutoNation, one of the largest automotive retailers in the United States, offers innovative products and exceptional services as part of a portfolio of comprehensive solutions for our customers and their automotive needs.
